sections.Profile:
"Alien Star," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1984, is a sci-fi-themed pinball machine featuring fast-paced gameplay with skill shots and a two-ball multiball system. Designed by John Trudeau with artwork by Larry Day, it utilizes the Gottlieb System 80A hardware.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1984
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Space, Solid State, Aliens, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, 1980s
sections.Design Team:
- Design: John Trudeau
- Art: Larry Day
- Sound: Craig Beierwaltes
